learning_outcomes.text: Explain the types, sections, and writing rules of technical reports.
Conduct a literature review on a scientific/technical topic, select reliable sources, and cite them appropriately.
Structure report content consistently and clearly with introduction, method, findings, discussion, and conclusion sections.
Support the report visually by effectively using tables, graphs, figures, and visuals.
Apply content planning, slide design, body language, voice use, and time management skills for an effective presentation.
Prepare reports and presentations within the framework of ethical principles; improve their work through peer review and feedback.

syllabus_topics: Types of scientific-technical writing, importance of written and oral presentation
Project-report process, scientific project and reporting
Preparation process related to the topic to be prepared
Planning report writing, report writing guide
Points to consider when writing a report
Definition of presentation, effective presentation techniques, points to consider before presentation and discussion of body language issues
Road map to make a good presentation
Preparing Effective Presentation Techniques and Preparing a Presentation
bibliography: BİLİMSEL ANLATIM – Yazılı ve Sözlü Sunum İlkeleri, Sinemis Yayınları, 2010.
